title: Auth — OOB Respond — payload
description: The lock holder delivers the member's signed decision on an out-of-band request by carrying a signed auth/oob/grant document. Issued and signed by the lock key `K_a`. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, parentThreadId, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

grant.description: A complete, signed auth/oob/grant/0.1 Trust Task document, issued by the identified DID and signed by its VTA for `assertionMethod`. The service verifies it as a document in its own right — envelope, proof and payload against that specification's schema — over the members exactly as received: its proof covers every member, so it is deliberately an open object here rather than a typed one a binding could narrow.

Response.title: Auth — OOB Respond — response payload
Response.description: The outcome the service recorded. It never contains session material: authority goes to the starter key, through auth/oob/redeem only.

status.description: `approved` when the grant approved and every check passed; `declined` when the grant declined.
